text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch, someone's already here.
Why is it so crowded today?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I thought no one would come up to the rooftop...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, whatever.
I'm gonna go take a nap over there."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... I'm sleeping over there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's already a big crowd here! How unusual.
Pardon the intrusion~

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ……? Something smells nice……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we'd better eat it before it gets cold.
Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Is that the smell of hamburgers...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Damn it, who's making it smell like meat around here!? How am I supposed to sleep with that distraction...!?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's me.
Nice weather, isn't it? Perfect day for a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... It's way too early for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This is my breakfast. I overslept and missed it earlier.
I was totally in the mood for a charcoal-grilled meat-on-meat burger, so I ordered it ahead of time to match our break.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh.
You ordered delivery? To the academy?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrumble~~~)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aha, want some?
I ordered the family pack out of habit,
so there's plenty.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, I am...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Really? When you're hungry is the best time to eat.
Your body absorbs nutrients much more efficiently in that state.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: High nutritional efficiency... I'll take it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: CB got me craving meat too. I'm taking one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ehh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......Ugh.
I think I might be getting full...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ……Geez…… Taishin-san, I'll take half.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I shall grant you my vegetables as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Eat that yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, coincidences like this are pretty fun too!
